verdict.rationale: Elicit documents that it generates research reports, including one that summarizes the relevant papers at the end of a Systematic Review. Reports export to PDF or Word on any plan, and sessions can be shared by link with people who have no account, so a shareable report with a summary is covered. However, no evidence describes the report's internal structure (named sections or embedded tables); tables are documented only as separate artifacts and CSV/Excel exports. missing for 10: documented sectioned report structure, tables embedded within the report itself, independent or hands-on corroboration of report quality and layout.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders

citations.quote: Enter any research question in Elicit to generate a research-backed report!
culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers
Research Reports can be exported as a PDF or Word file, regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to.
Toggle on "Anyone with the link can view", then click "Copy link". This works for people without an Elicit account
Tables can be exported in CSV and Excel format.
